notes: Ground truth skill annotations, manually created by the developer who authored each fictional sample CV. Used to calculate Precision, Recall, and F1-Score for the NLP skill extraction module, as committed in the ethics approval and requested by supervisor feedback. 'ground_truth_skills' lists skills that are genuinely present in the CV text (by meaning), regardless of whether the exact dictionary term is used verbatim - this is what a human reviewer would reasonably credit the candidate with.

annotations.profile: Tricky - uncommon abbreviations/phrasing (JS, Postgres, Mongo, ExpressJS, RESTful services)
annotations.note: This CV intentionally uses abbreviations/synonyms (JS, Node, ExpressJS, Postgres, Mongo, RESTful services) instead of exact dictionary terms, to test whether the extractor's exact-match approach fails on real-world phrasing variation.

annotations.profile: Sparse/weak - vague soft-skill language, minimal concrete technical skills
annotations.note: This CV deliberately contains almost no concrete, named technical skills, and describes soft skills in vague/paraphrased language (e.g. 'quick learner', 'hard working') rather than dictionary terms. Used to test extractor behavior on a low-signal, realistic weak CV.
